value.rationale: The total opposite-Betti defect is an intrinsic L1 measure of rational Poincaré duality failure, not merely one endpoint dimension. Sharp global extremization across every exceptional full-flag F4 Schubert variety, uniquely characterized up to diagram symmetry by two involutions, is a naturally complete geometric classification. It is not presented as a new method for single Bruhat intervals or as a claim in other types.
